title: ilex × hodginsii
intro: Ilex × hodginsii, commonly known as a hybrid between American holly (Ilex opaca) and Japanese holly (Ilex crenata), is a plant species. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ilex × hodginsii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, that may help modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
